en.t: Oh, male dogs have it easy; they are always beautiful.
Female dogs, on the other hand, look listless and worn out.

units.source_text: 长毛狗产仔后，狗毛脱落精光，狗主人也就把原先对母狗的爱转移到小狗身上啰。”

en.t: After a long-haired dog gives birth, all her fur falls out, and the owner simply transfers the affection once given to the mother dog over to the puppies.
